metadata_basis.article_statement: Corolla colour is a discrete trait with three states (yellow, lilac, white), and colour did not vary among individuals within species.
metadata_basis.dryad_exact_package_filename: R codes and data from Evolution #15-0052.zip

source_admission_rules.exact_package_filename_required: R codes and data from Evolution #15-0052.zip
source_admission_rules.tree_identity: Freeze only an author-code-referenced phylogeny/tree object from the exact Dryad package before trait rows are opened.
source_admission_rules.trait_identity: Freeze only the author-code-referenced species-level floral-trait object/file from the exact Dryad package before row values are opened.

phenotype_schema_freeze.fine_state: exact source-defined corolla-colour category after trim/lowercase/whitespace normalization only
phenotype_schema_freeze.coarse_state: WHITE iff source-defined fine label is exactly white; yellow and lilac are NONWHITE
phenotype_schema_freeze.source_code_mapping_rule: If the raw trait object is coded numerically or symbolically, admit only if the exact author code/package provides an unambiguous pre-row mapping from raw codes to the three published labels yellow/lilac/white. Freeze that mapping before opening species-level colour values.
phenotype_schema_freeze.unmapped_code_rule: HOLD_SCHEMA; do not infer or retrofit a mapping after row-level colour exposure.
phenotype_schema_freeze.unexpected_label_rule: HOLD_SCHEMA; do not merge or reinterpret unexpected labels.

crosswalk_rule.method: Freeze exact normalized species/terminal intersection before species-level colour values are opened.

hidden_memory_test.null: permute retained fine labels within coarse groups preserving fine-state counts
hidden_memory_test.pass_rule: centered conditional AUC > 0 and one-sided permutation P <= 0.05

optional_temporal_prediction.predictor: fine-state signed excess-retention area across relative divergence depth
optional_temporal_prediction.role: secondary out-of-sample realization prediction; cannot rescue primary hidden-memory decision
